notes.title: [Update 1-9] Bugfixes
notes.content:
Hello,

the past 9 updates fixed the following things:

- A bunch of wrong signs
- "weird" Keybindings
- some minor visual issues
- An issue where savegames wouldnt save the correct level but the previous one

Thats all, without going too much into detail.
Sorry for the issues, and thank you.
